name: Rakazo v0.8 Persistent AI Teammates
description: Open-source AI teammates with memory, routines and their own computers.

upstream.image: ghcr.io/elie222/rakazo/app:v0.8.0@sha256:908045c3b393f4d948ea6bed9cd86ab77fd32d467d2fdfa042805b34c5b851ea (index; linux/amd64 sha256:bd8658b08be21316b2dd73d15d7ec8a9f166f82b044b6992a40ebb1a017dca05, linux/arm64 sha256:54ab3e99115c19989ea8e85d3c2cd0f99e9a19e956f82d5ef86ac159550ca1d3; built 2026-11-04, revision label = tag commit)

PORT.description: Port of the web app (Vite preview server). The public domain and Railway's healthcheck use it; keep 5173.

RAKAZO_HOST.description: Hostname the web server answers to. After attaching a custom domain, set it to that hostname (no https://).

RAKAZO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Extra hostnames the web server accepts, comma-separated. Keep healthcheck.railway.app so Railway's healthcheck passes.

API_PROXY_TARGET.description: Private address of the API. The web server forwards /api and /rpc there, so the API has no public domain.

SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET.description: Shared with the API: signs the links that open a bot computer's live screen.

RAYON_NUM_THREADS.description: Threads the Vite preview server uses to bundle its config at start (it would otherwise start one per host CPU).

RAKAZO_IMAGE_TAG.description: Version label the web app reports. Informational; the image digest decides the version.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds open requests get to finish when a redeploy replaces the web server.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email. Before the app goes online, an account with this email and OWNER_PASSWORD is created. Public sign-up stays closed.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Generated password for OWNER_EMAIL (16+ characters). Copy it from here to sign in; change it in account settings. Later edits do not reset it.

SIGNUPS_ENABLED.description: Public sign-up. false keeps this a private install; true with SIGNUP_ALLOWLIST lets listed emails register (needs email set up).

PORT.description: Port the API listens on; Railway's healthcheck (GET /ready) uses it. Keep equal to API_PORT.

API_PORT.description: Port the API listens on (upstream variable). Keep equal to PORT.

API_HOST.description: Listen address. :: answers on the private network over IPv4 and IPv6; the API has no public domain.

RAKAZO_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Public HTTPS address of the app. After attaching a custom domain to Web, set https://{your-domain} here and RAKAZO_HOST on Web.

WEB_ORIGIN.description: Web app origin for cookies, CORS and passkeys (upstream variable). Follows RAKAZO_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

API_URL.description: Public base URL used in links and webhooks (upstream variable). Follows RAKAZO_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Only the Web service may report a client address, so sign-in rate limits and logs see the real visitor.

CLIENT_IP_HEADER.description: Header with the visitor's address: Railway's edge sets X-Real-IP and the Web service passes it on unchanged.

DATABASE_URL.description: App login (rakazo_app, row-level security enforced). Created by the pre-deploy migration.

RAKAZO_DB_APP_PASSWORD.description: Password of the rakazo_app login, generated at deploy (hex, URL-safe). A change applies on the next deploy.

DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL.description: Database owner, used only by the pre-deploy step (migrations, app login). Removed from the API's environment before it starts.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored credentials, chat content and files. Generated at deploy. Back it up and never change it: data cannot be read without it.

CONTENT_ENCRYPTION.description: on encrypts messages, memory and files at rest (upstream default for servers); off stores new content readable.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions. Generated at deploy; changing it signs everyone out.

SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET.description: Signs links to a bot computer's live screen. Generated at deploy; Web reads it from here.

DATA_DIR.description: Local cache and staging folder. Bot homes and files are stored in the Bucket, so no volume is needed.

OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket for bot computer homes and files (encrypted before upload). Shared by API and Worker.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint of the Railway Bucket.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key of the Railway Bucket.

OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key of the Railway Bucket.

WAKEUP_DRIVER.description: Job queue in Postgres (Graphile Worker); no Redis needed.

SANDBOX_PROVIDER.description: Where bot computers run: railway (needs RAILWAY_API_TOKEN), e2b, daytona, boat, or none. Without the matching key, computers stay off and chat works.

RAILWAY_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Railway WORKSPACE token for bot computers as Railway sandboxes (billed to that workspace). It can manage every project in the workspace: use a dedicated one.

RAILWAY_SANDBOX_REGION.description: Optional Railway region for new computers. Empty = Railway's default (US West).

RAILWAY_SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT_ID.description: Advanced. Existing empty environment for computers. Empty = an environment named sbx-... is created in this project. Never this app's environment.

E2B_API_KEY.description: Optional. E2B key, used when SANDBOX_PROVIDER=e2b.

DAYTONA_API_KEY.description: Optional. Daytona key, used when SANDBOX_PROVIDER=daytona.

BOAT_API_KEY.description: Optional. Boat (boat.dev) key, used when SANDBOX_PROVIDER=boat.

SANDBOX_IDLE_MS.description: A computer stops after this many idle milliseconds (10 minutes); its files are saved first. Paid computers stop billing when stopped.

COMPUTER_MAX_ACTIVE_MS.description: Longest uninterrupted run of a paid computer (2 hours) unless a run or person is using it. 0 turns the cap off.

SANDBOX_MAX_COMPUTERS_PER_USER.description: Most computers one user's bots may have (cost guard). 0 = no cap.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional deployment model key (OpenRouter). Leave empty to connect a model in Settings, Models after signing in.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional deployment model key, used with PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=anthropic.

PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER.description: Optional deployment model provider: openrouter (default when empty), anthropic or deepseek.

PI_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Optional deployment model id. Empty uses the provider's upstream default. Pick a vision model so screen tools work.

COMPOSIO_API_KEY.description: Optional Composio key for connected apps (Gmail, Slack, GitHub and more).

EMAIL_PROVIDER.description: Optional: resend to send password-reset and sign-in emails over Resend's HTTP API.

EMAIL_API_KEY.description: Optional Resend sending key (domain-restricted), with EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional sender, for example Rakazo <hello@mail.example.com>, on a domain verified at the email provider.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error or off.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the old API gets to finish requests and chat replies when a redeploy replaces it.

RAKAZO_API_READY_URL.description: The worker waits (up to 15 minutes) until the API answers here, so the schema is migrated before jobs start.

DATABASE_URL.description: Same app login as the API (row-level security enforced).

API_URL.description: Public base URL used in links the worker sends.

DATA_DIR.description: Local cache and staging folder; homes and files live in the Bucket.

OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Same Railway Bucket as the API.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint of the Railway Bucket.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key of the Railway Bucket.

OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key of the Railway Bucket.

SANDBOX_PROVIDER.description: Same computer provider as the API (routines use computers too). Change it on the API.

RAILWAY_API_TOKEN.description: Same token as the API. Set it on the API.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Same as the API (routines run here).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Up to 45 minutes for running routines and background jobs to finish on redeploy (upstream's drain limit). It ends as soon as they finish.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database is initialized (inside the volume).

PGUSER.description: Database owner, for the Data panel and the migrations.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Data panel and the app.

PGPASSWORD.description: Owner password for the Data panel.

DATABASE_URL.description: Owner connection string on the private network. Only the API's pre-deploy step uses it.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate in days.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Owner password, generated at deploy (letters only, URL-safe).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.
